title: The Borrowed Bell Unreturned
youtube_title: The Borrowed Bell Unreturned | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Owning a mistake is how trust grows back.
summary: At a cottage hallway of hooks, rugs, and boots, Violeta is tangled up with a little bell borrowed from the shop display and almost hides it. Violeta tells the baker the plain truth, and together they mend what can be mended, with no teasing.
